name: Percent & discounts
tip: Percent means 'per 100'. To get p% of n, multiply n by p/100. For a discount, the buyer pays (100 − p)% of the price.
tipTl: Ang percent ay 'kada 100'. Para kunin ang p% ng n: n × p/100. Sa discount, ang babayaran ay (100 − p)% ng presyo.

name: Fractions & decimals
tip: Add or subtract only when the denominators match. Multiply straight across. To divide, keep–change–flip.
tipTl: Mag-add o subtract lang kapag pareho na ang denominator. Sa multiplication, diretso lang. Sa division: keep–change–flip.

name: Equations & algebra
tip: Do the same thing to both sides. Undo + and − first, then × and ÷. Always plug your answer back in to check — on a multiple-choice test you can also test each choice.
tipTl: Kung ano ang ginawa mo sa isang side, gawin din sa kabila. Pwede mo ring i-test ang bawat choice — i-plug-in sa equation.

name: Number sequences
tip: Write the gap between neighbours. Constant gap = add. Constant ratio = multiply. Growing gaps = look at the gaps of the gaps.
tipTl: Isulat ang pagitan ng bawat numero. Pare-pareho? Add. Pare-parehong ratio? Multiply. Lumalaki ang pagitan? Tingnan ang pagitan ng pagitan.

name: Speed, distance & time
tip: Speed = distance ÷ time. Convert minutes to hours (÷ 60) before answering in km/h.
tipTl: Bilis = layo ÷ oras. Gawing oras muna ang minutes (÷ 60) kung km/h ang hinahanap.

name: Work & proportion
tip: Find what ONE worker does in ONE unit of time, then scale up. More workers → less time; more work → more time.
tipTl: Alamin ang kaya ng ISANG tao sa ISANG oras/araw, tapos i-scale. Mas maraming tao → mas mabilis.

name: Geometry & measurement
tip: Know the basics: rectangle area = l × w, triangle = ½ × b × h, circle = πr², circumference = 2πr, cube volume = s³, right triangle: a² + b² = c².
tipTl: Kabisaduhin: rectangle = l × w, triangle = ½ × b × h, circle = πr², 2πr, cube = s³, Pythagoras a² + b² = c².

name: Averages & statistics
tip: Mean = total ÷ count. Median = middle value after sorting. Mode = most frequent. Range = highest − lowest.
tipTl: Mean = total ÷ ilan. Median = nasa gitna (i-sort muna). Mode = pinakamadalas. Range = pinakamataas − pinakamababa.

name: Word problems
tip: Underline what is asked. Write the givens as numbers, pick the operation, and estimate first so you can spot a wrong choice.
tipTl: Salungguhitan kung ano ang tinatanong. Isulat ang givens, piliin ang operation, at mag-estimate muna.

name: Number codes
tip: Compare each input with its output: try n², n² + n, 2n + k, n × (n + k). Test your rule on ALL the given pairs before answering.
tipTl: Ihambing ang input at output. Subukan ang n², n² + n, 2n + k. I-test ang rule sa LAHAT ng pairs bago sumagot.

name: Number & letter series
tip: For letters, turn them into positions (A=1, B=2 …). Then look for the pattern in the gaps, just like number series.
tipTl: Sa letters, gawing numero (A=1, B=2 …). Tapos hanapin ang pattern sa pagitan.

name: Data interpretation
tip: Read the labels and units first. Most items ask for a total, average, difference, or percent change = (new − old) ÷ old × 100.
tipTl: Basahin muna ang labels. Karaniwang tanong: total, average, difference, o percent change = (bago − luma) ÷ luma × 100.

name: Word analogies
tip: Make a sentence that links the first pair ("A book is used for reading"). The correct choice fits the same sentence.
tipTl: Gumawa ng sentence na nag-uugnay sa unang pair. Ang tamang sagot ay babagay sa parehong sentence.

name: Syllogisms & logic
tip: Draw circles (Venn). "All A are B" puts A inside B. "Some" only overlaps. If a conclusion isn't forced by the drawing, it doesn't follow.
tipTl: Mag-drawing ng bilog (Venn). "Lahat ng A ay B" = nasa loob ng B ang A. Kung hindi siguradong totoo, hindi ito valid na conclusion.

name: Family relations
tip: Draw a mini family tree. Mark each person's gender only when the question says it.
tipTl: Mag-drawing ng maliit na family tree. Huwag manghula ng gender kung hindi sinabi.

name: Assumptions
tip: An assumption is the unstated belief the statement needs to make sense. If you deny it and the statement falls apart, it is the assumption.
tipTl: Ang assumption ay paniniwalang hindi sinabi pero kailangan para may saysay ang pahayag.

name: Odd one out
tip: Find the group three of them share (fruits, mammals, instruments). The one outside the group is the answer.
tipTl: Hanapin ang grupo ng tatlo. Ang hindi kasama ang sagot.

name: Vocabulary & meaning in context
tip: Replace the word with each choice and read the sentence again. The right one keeps the meaning; watch for positive vs negative tone.
tipTl: Ipalit ang bawat choice sa salita at basahin ulit. Ang tama ay hindi magbabago ang kahulugan. Pansinin kung positive o negative.

name: Antonyms
tip: First think of a synonym, then look for its opposite. Beware of choices that are synonyms — they are traps.
tipTl: Isipin muna ang kasingkahulugan, saka hanapin ang kasalungat. Ingat sa choices na kasingkahulugan — trap iyon.

name: Grammar & usage
tip: Find the real subject (skip phrases like "of the students") and match the verb. Collective nouns (group, flock) usually take a singular verb.
tipTl: Hanapin ang tunay na subject at itugma ang verb. Ang collective nouns (group, flock) ay karaniwang singular.

name: Spelling
tip: Say the word slowly by syllables. Common traps: double letters (occasion, accommodate), -ence/-ance, ie/ei.
tipTl: Bigkasin nang dahan-dahan bawat pantig. Karaniwang mali: double letters, -ence/-ance, ie/ei.

name: Sentence & paragraph order
tip: Find the opening (introduces the topic) and look for time words and cause → effect. Check the order by reading it as a story.
tipTl: Hanapin ang simula, tapos sundan ang oras at sanhi → bunga. Basahin na parang kuwento para ma-check.

name: Verbal analogies
tip: Name the relationship (use, opposite, part of, place). Apply the same relationship to the second pair.
tipTl: Pangalanan ang relasyon (gamit, kasalungat, bahagi, lugar), tapos ilapat sa pangalawang pair.

name: Reading comprehension
tip: Read the question first, then the passage. The main idea covers the WHOLE passage — not one detail. Inferences must be supported by the text.
tipTl: Basahin muna ang tanong. Ang main idea ay sumasaklaw sa BUONG passage. Ang inference ay dapat suportado ng teksto.

name: Filipino: wika at gramatika
tip: Know ng vs nang, raw/rin after vowels (daw/din after consonants), and common idioms (sawikain).
tipTl: Alamin ang ng vs nang, raw/rin kapag patinig ang dulo (daw/din kapag katinig), at mga sawikain.

name: 1987 Philippine Constitution
tip: Memorize the numbers: President/VP 6 yrs; Senators 24, 6 yrs, 2 terms; House 3 yrs, 3 terms; Supreme Court 1 + 14, retire at 70.
tipTl: Kabisaduhin: President/VP 6 taon; Senador 24, 6 taon, 2 terms; Kongresista 3 taon, 3 terms; Korte Suprema 1 + 14, retiro sa 70.

name: RA 6713 & public service ethics
tip: RA 6713 lists 8 norms of conduct, requires replies to requests within 15 working days, and a SALN filed on or before April 30.
tipTl: Sa RA 6713: 8 norms of conduct, sagutin ang request sa loob ng 15 working days, SALN bago o sa April 30.

name: Peace & human rights
tip: Know the Bill of Rights (Art. III), the Commission on Human Rights (Art. XIII), and the UDHR (adopted Dec 10, 1948).
tipTl: Alamin ang Bill of Rights (Art. III), Commission on Human Rights (Art. XIII), at UDHR (Dec 10, 1948).

name: Environment laws
tip: Match the law to its number: RA 9003 solid waste, RA 8749 clean air, RA 9275 clean water, RA 9729 climate change.
tipTl: Itugma ang batas sa numero: RA 9003 basura, RA 8749 hangin, RA 9275 tubig, RA 9729 climate change.

name: Philippine history & culture
tip: Useful background knowledge. The official General Information scope focuses on the Constitution, RA 6713, human rights and the environment.
tipTl: Magandang background. Pero ang focus ng General Information ay Constitution, RA 6713, human rights at environment.

name: Current events (PH)
tip: Recent laws, programs and events (2024 onward). The real CSE often asks about them. Each item is dated: facts are as of the month shown in the explanation.
tipTl: Mga bagong batas, programa at events (2024 pataas). Madalas itong lumabas sa totoong CSE. May petsa ang bawat item: totoo ang facts as of sa buwan na nakasulat sa explanation.

name: General knowledge
tip: World and science trivia. Good for general awareness, but lower priority for the CSE.
tipTl: World at science trivia. Okay para sa general knowledge pero mas mababa ang priority para sa CSE.
